source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Open a word doc and input all of the facility information from the inspection sheet - Facility Type / SQF Inspections / No Access / Accessibility Inspection No. / Date Scope Performed / Date / Phone Number/ Address / Field Inspector
3. Open the original accessibility inspection sheet and input any notes for the inspection. 

## For any facility where an inspection was not performed: 

1. For each facility, open a word doc and input all of the facility information from the inspection sheet - Facility Type / SQF Inspections / No Access / Accessibility Inspection No. / Date Scope Performed / Date / Phone Number/ Address / Field Inspector
2. In the comments, input the reasons why an inspection was not performed.
3. Save the Word Document using the following format: "failed inspection: ACCESSIBILITY: [full facility name]" where square brackets mean that the text within should be filled in with the appropriate information for that facility.
